subject: Assessment of take two qualified on your three points (rig timing not established in take two; the interpretation is a hypothesis and the frame-landmark wording untested; the parted-lips source exception kept in any mouth-as-state prompt); rehashed; no take three
body:
All three applied at 03:00 UTC; the qualified assessment supersedes the one attached to 9f171259: SIGNAL_002_ASSESSMENT_20261014.md, sha256 5f50656df9711bb9b62ad9ba2054887dfcce34f073f59482fed11d9737b15f57, 7,694 bytes.

1. The rig's timing. Take two's scene line no longer says the rig is gone by the fifth second; it says rig structure and fire are still visible inside the dust at 5.5 s (frame 132) and the rig is gone by the last sample (frame 191), so the beat at which it goes under lies between and is not established from the samples; take one's timing does not transfer. My error: I carried take one's reading across.
2. The interpretation. The sentence about how the generator resolved "his own right", "pushes forward" and the lips-closing line is now labelled a hypothesis, not a finding: one result consistent with directional ambiguity, which does not prove how the words were read. Section 3 is retitled "the next approach for the structure (proposed; untested)" and says a take three would be the test of it. The template's rule is reworded the same way (SHOT_DIRECTION_TEMPLATE.md, sha256 51893b0976a03e5ab27fc5974dca4e9e06e4e63f8c10817998e8c2db0b78402e, 5,228 bytes): the frame-term wording is the approach to try next, the generator's handling of a character's left and right a hypothesis from one result, untested until a take runs on it.
3. The mouth. The proposed take-three wording keeps the source's exact exception: "His lips, slightly parted in the first frame, close during the first half-second; from then on the mouth stays closed and the lips still, no speech," with the negative reading "open the mouth or move the lips after it closes in the first half-second". The template's mouth-as-state line carries the same exception.

L4 and S5 stand as the writer's attributed preliminary aesthetic judgment; technical checks and human acceptance stay separate; no take three is executed or requested by anything of mine; the original is preserved. DECISIONS item 55 carries the qualification (file sha256 42831251d9b977333bf92e2ae343bdb605df4f77af9e2d3a62d8d4ef835f9781).
